root_cause.text: The function `mana_hwc_destroy_channel()` frees the hardware channel's caller context (`hwc->caller_ctx`) before destroying the completion queue (CQ) and event queue (EQ), allowing concurrent, in-flight interrupt handlers to dereference the freed memory before IRQ synchronization occurs.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows `kfree(hwc->caller_ctx)` being moved from the beginning of `mana_hwc_destroy_channel()` to after the destruction of the TX/RX work queues and the CQ (`mana_hwc_destroy_cq`). Additionally, the commit message states that "the IRQ synchronization only happens in mana_hwc_destroy_cq() ... Since this runs after kfree(hwc->caller_ctx), a concurrent mana_hwc_rx_event_handler() can dereference freed caller_ctx".
